title: Hourly Auto-Dig:Anduril Sparrows Point primary-record follow-up
summary: Dataset-first CIA pass advances the queued Anduril Sparrows Point MOU/incentive target, preserves Costa Mesa principal-place semantics, distinguishes Tradepoint Atlantic site geography from an unverified Anduril facility address, and queues executed-record recovery without filler ingestion.

sources.title: Anduril Weighs Baltimore Shipyard Investment to Build Drone Boats

data.research_question: Has primary evidence materially changed Anduril's reported Sparrows Point facility status, and what public-location semantics can be defended without conflating Tradepoint Atlantic site geography with Anduril headquarters or facility geography?
data.method: Refreshed current main and open hourly PR state through the GitHub connector. Reused the latest merged reproducible 54-entry dataset/topic universe. Excluded recent/active hourly surfaces for hunter-biden, wef, influence-watch-db, and gop, leaving 47 eligible entries. Using run seed 20260819155242 over the sorted eligible pool selected cia. The latest explicit CIA queued frontier exposed the Anduril Sparrows Point MOU/incentive target. Reviewed current first-party Tradepoint Atlantic site, development, and location pages; Anduril's previously captured current principal-place evidence; Maryland government search results; and current reporting through 2026-08-19. Tradepoint Atlantic publishes its own office/corporate address and site-wide development incentives, but no reviewed primary record establishes an Anduril-specific address, lease, incentive award, permit, or operational facility. Current reporting still describes an MOU and unsigned final lease. No material primary-source development justified a new facility event, so no filler event was created.
classification_rules: Dataset-stage sampling is across dataset/topic entries rather than row counts.
Recent successful or directly overlapping active hourly surfaces are excluded when alternatives exist.
Anduril principal place of business, headquarters locality, proposed facility, Tradepoint Atlantic corporate address, and Tradepoint Atlantic site access points remain distinct semantics.
Site-wide incentive eligibility is not a project-specific award.
Reported MOU is not an executed lease or operational facility.
Current news is ingested only when it materially changes the selected investigation.

findings.selection_algorithm: sort the latest merged 54-entry dataset/topic universe; remove recent/active hourly topic surfaces; choose eligible_pool[seed mod len(eligible_pool)]; then select the explicit queued CIA Sparrows Point primary-record target

findings.result: Tradepoint Atlantic's 6995 Bethlehem Blvd office/corporate address is site-owner geography, not an Anduril facility or headquarters address.

No reviewed primary source through 2026-08-19 established an executed Anduril Sparrows Point lease, project-specific incentive approval, permit, construction start, or operational facility; no filler event created.
